info.description: Self-analysis of the TARAflow desktop application, extended to v0.19.0-beta: renderer, preload bridge, Electron main process, git audit trail, OS keychain, draw.io iframe, Tailwind CDN, issue trackers, update check and file system — and since 0.19 the import of component TARAs from another team's repository (file, git history via git:rawInDir, fetch from the component's remote), Resolve of source references against software source repositories, and the CLIs (taraflow-verify, taraflow-report). The 0.19 elements were added without threats: open the project and synchronise the threats and risks. Method: TARAflow standard (harm-floor impact, weighted-mean likelihood). Tagged CRA as yardstick — whether the CRA legally applies to free, non-commercial open-source software is a separate question. Initial risk is rated without any controls; existing controls and the hardening plan (doc/Open/Security/electron-security-boundary-hardening.md) appear as mitigations.
